pop_estimate.name: Estimated resident population
pop_estimate.caveat: Estimated at 30 June. Rebased after each census (2023 rebase).

pop_median_age.name: Median age
pop_median_age.caveat: Half the population is older and half younger. Estimated at 30 June.

bds_geographic_units.name: Business locations (geographic units)
bds_geographic_units.caveat: Business locations (geographic units) with economic activity, at February each year. Counts randomly rounded.

bds_employee_count.name: Employees in business locations
bds_employee_count.caveat: Employee count at February. Counts randomly rounded.

msd_main_benefits_total.name: Working-age people on a main benefit
msd_main_benefits_total.caveat: Working-age (18–64) recipients at the end of each quarter. Counts randomly rounded to base 3.

msd_jobseeker.name: Jobseeker Support recipients
msd_jobseeker.caveat: Best Tairāwhiti-only labour-market signal: the HLFS unemployment rate is only published for Gisborne/Hawke's Bay combined.

msd_supported_living.name: Supported Living Payment recipients
msd_supported_living.caveat: Includes carers and people with a health condition or disability; a rise is not necessarily negative.

rent_geomean.name: Mean weekly rent, new bonds (geometric mean)
rent_geomean.caveat: Private-landlord bonds lodged in the month. Fixed random rounding; months with fewer than 5 bonds suppressed.

hud_register_applicants.name: Social housing register applicants
hud_register_applicants.caveat: Housing Register plus Transfer Register, at month end.

hud_social_housing_chp.name: Social housing places – community housing providers

hud_eh_grants.name: Emergency housing grants approved
hud_eh_grants.caveat: Emergency Housing Special Needs Grants. Monthly counts are small and volatile.

imms_6m.name: Children fully immunised at 6 months
imms_6m.caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. National target is 95%.

imms_24m.name: Children fully immunised at 24 months
imms_24m.caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. Health target: 95% by 24 months.

cas_dsi.name: Road deaths and serious injuries
cas_dsi.caveat: Calendar year. CAS is live: recent years may still change. Current year is year-to-date.

cas_deaths.name: Road deaths
cas_deaths.caveat: Small annual numbers; read multi-year trends, not single years.
